opinions.point: The episode was widely viewed as strong, especially for expanding Gyro’s characterization and motivation.
Many commenters praised the dramatic direction and the way the episode gave emotional weight to its character-focused material.
The ending generated enthusiastic reactions, particularly from viewers enjoying the series’ bizarre body-horror style.
Several commenters enjoyed the returning voice performances and callbacks to earlier JoJo parts.
Sound design, music, and vocal performances were repeatedly described as effective or memorable.
Commenters generally found the humor, character designs, and exaggerated JoJo presentation entertaining.
Some viewers felt transitions or rearranged material made parts of the episode feel abrupt, even while they liked the overall result.
A small number of comments criticized a noticeable animation dip near the end and found some healing or injury logic inconsistent.
